_unmeasured: CHECKER_SANDBOX_FIX_BLIND_TO_STEVE (owner 2026-11-04: an inability to measure is reported up for fix and repair, never a FAIL): a Marker's UNMEASURED, or a FAIL whose reasons only say the box could not reach its evidence (relentless_wall.read_as), sends no work back and changes no approach. With reach_repair on (the default) the first blind check ends the checking and the Judge's own repair takes over (see _reach_repair). Only with reach_repair false: the candidate is checked again after unmeasured_recheck_s; unmeasured_limit in a row on one sha holds it (kind unmeasured) until the box or the contract's offbox reading is repaired. offbox_max_s bounds all of a check's off-box readings together (one deadline); offbox_adapters are the only things that run.
_reach_repair: BLIND_JUDGE_BUILD_FIXES_OWN_EYES (owner 2026-11-05: 'The JUDGE is the one who can't measure something, so the JUDGE should fix it'; 'It should only file a ticket if it is unable to make the fix itself'). With reach_repair on, the FIRST UNMEASURED verdict ends the checking: no clock re-check, unmeasured_limit and unmeasured_recheck_s unused. The Judge's verdict --propose (an offbox adapter name or a read path) is its repair; the first item blind on a reach_classes class owns it, others block on that owner. relentless_reachfix.sweep probes it from inside the wall; pass = the supervisor's add-only overlay and one check of the same sha; fail (or blind again after a pass) = the class's ticket, and everyone blocks on it until it closes and the probe passes. reach_never: read paths no repair may ever open.

reach_classes._why: a Windows program run from inside the wall (dotnet.exe on a \\wsl.localhost path, HEAVY_TEXTURES_MEASURE_REAL_VRAM): no read path opens it, so it goes straight to its ticket unless the Judge names an adapter

offbox_adapters._doc: Supervisor-owned off-box readings (GPT review of 0135b04912: no worker-authored command crosses the Marker's wall). A contract or unhold --offbox names one of these; the supervisor runs its argv with no shell, from an empty folder, with output capped at relentless_wall.OFFBOX_OUT_MAX bytes and all of a check's readings sharing offbox_max_s. `script` is the plain text of an -EncodedCommand, for review: they must match (selftest_relentless_blind).
offbox_adapters._doc_slots: CHECKER_REACH_BUILD_GIT_AND_GH_ADAPTERS: an argv token may hold {sha} (the candidate commit, 40 hex) and {repo} (the check's clean clone outside the wall, full history, checked out at {sha}); relentless_wall.fill_argv fills them from the supervisor's own values, shape-checked, and an adapter it cannot fill is reported, never run. No other slot exists, and no worker text ever fills one.

seat_clone_state.what: the seat clones the box masks, read now on this machine (CHECKER_REACH_FIX_CLONES_STILL_DARK): per clone ~/rm/bench and ~/rm/foundry one line 'HEAD= origin_main_ref= github_main_now= github_main_fetched= ahead= behind= head_in_origin_main= branch= dirty=N' (ahead/behind against the clone's own origin/main ref; nothing is fetched), then up to 60 'git status --porcelain' lines, conversations/ excluded; file names only, never contents
argv:
import os, subprocess
for name in ('bench', 'foundry'):
    d = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser('~/rm/' + name))
    def g(*a):
        x = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d] + list(a), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        return x.stdout.strip() if x.returncode == 0 else 'ERR:' + (x.stderr.strip().splitlines() or ['?'])[-1][:120]
    if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(d, '.git')):
        print(name, d, 'NO_CLONE')
        continue
    head, om = g('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), g('rev-parse', 'refs/remotes/origin/main')
    rn = g('ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main').split()
    rn = rn[0] if rn and not rn[0].startswith('ERR') else 'UNREAD'
    known = rn != 'UNREAD' and g('cat-file', '-t', rn) == 'commit'
    lr = g('rev-list', '--left-right', '--count', 'HEAD...refs/remotes/origin/main').split()
    anc = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', 'HEAD', 'refs/remotes/origin/main'], capture_output=True, timeout=60).returncode == 0
    dirty = [l for l in g('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all', '--', '.', ':(exclude)conversations').splitlines() if l.strip()]
    print(name, d, 'HEAD=%s origin_main_ref=%s github_main_now=%s github_main_fetched=%s ahead=%s behind=%s head_in_origin_main=%s branch=%s dirty=%d' % (
        head, om, rn, known, lr[0] if len(lr) == 2 else '?', lr[1] if len(lr) == 2 else '?', anc, g('rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD'), len(dirty)))
    for l in dirty[:60]:
        print('  ' + l)
    if len(dirty) > 60:
        print('  ... %d more' % (len(dirty) - 60))
